remarks: Updated 3BR/1BA home in heart of Riverside Greenwich and zoned for the coveted International School at Dundee. (ISD) Windowed, renovated kitchen with custom cabinets, granite countertops and stainless steel applicances. The windowed bathroom has also been updated and features granite vanity top, new lighting. 3 Lovely bedrooms. Shared use of the back yard. 2 off-street parking spaces right in front on home and use of the garage for parking with access to Washer/dryer. Conveniently located within walking distance of Riverside Commons shopping center and quick access to i95. Landlord pays for trash/snow removal and landscaping. Tenant pays all utilities. Please have excellent credit. No Pets
